dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Look, Nam! That's the actress who won the award last year.
dialogue.reading: ˈlʊk, ˈnɑːm! ðæts ði ˈæktrəs huː ˈwʌn ði əˈwɔːrd ˈlæst ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's my favorite star. She was in the drama that we watched last month.
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈstɑːr. ʃiː wʌz ɪn ðə ˈdrɑːmə ðæt wiː ˈwɑːtʃt ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, the drama which made me cry?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ðə ˈdrɑːmə wɪtʃ ˈmeɪd miː ˈkraɪ?

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And who's the man who's standing next to her?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈhuːz ðə ˈmæn huːz ˈstændɪŋ ˈnɛkst tə hɜːr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He's a singer who's very famous in Thailand.
dialogue.reading: hiːz ə ˈsɪŋər huːz ˈvɛri ˈfeɪməs ɪn ˈtaɪlænd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: He's going to sing a song that he wrote for his mom.
dialogue.reading: hiːz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsɪŋ ə ˈsɔːŋ ðæt hiː ˈroʊt fər hɪz ˈmɑːm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: That's sweet. Is this a show which is on every year?
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈswiːt. ɪz ðɪs ə ˈʃoʊ wɪtʃ ɪz ɑːn ˈɛvri ˈjɪr?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. It's the biggest award show in Thailand. Everyone watches it.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. ɪts ðə ˈbɪɡɪst əˈwɔːrd ˈʃoʊ ɪn ˈtaɪlænd. ˈɛvriwʌn ˈwɑːtʃɪz ɪt.
